_comment: Pins the one cell issue #117 found unpinned: whether waiving the decline guard also waives its require_vote_quorum conjunct. RFC-MACP-0007 6.2 defines the guard as a two-conjunct conjunction and then waives 'the decline guard' without saying whether the waiver reaches the quorum half. It does -- the guard is waived whole. Companion to decision_finalize_decline_empty_tally.json, whose only material difference is that it never sets require_vote_quorum, which is precisely why the corpus could not see this disagreement before.
description: Decision Mode: an objection-authorized decline is not denied for an unmet voting quorum -- the waiver of the decline guard covers its require_vote_quorum conjunct.

policy.description: Majority vote with a participation floor AND require_vote_quorum, plus a critical-objection veto that finalizes as a decline.

messages._comment: Triply blocked, and POLICY_DENIED is the only producible code: the standing critical objection vetoes the positive direction, the schema_version 3 empty-tally rule fails every algorithm other than 'none', and the participation floor of 1 is unmet at zero voters. Mode validation passes -- an accepted Proposal exists and the sender is the authorized initiator -- so every remaining ground is policy-layer, and RFC-MACP-0012 6.4 runs policy governance only after mode validation passes.

payload.reason: attempt to commit over a standing critical objection with no ballots cast

messages._comment: THE DISCRIMINATOR for issue #117. Zero ballots have been cast, so the participation floor of 1 is UNMET and require_vote_quorum is true. A runtime that keeps the quorum conjunct applying to an objection-authorized decline rejects this message and fails the fixture. It must be accepted: the waiver covers the decline guard whole. The quorum condition legitimizes an outcome deriving its authority from the voting result, and this decline derives none -- its authorization is the recorded critical Objection. The strict reading is not the conservative choice; it reconstructs the stuck state finalize_decline exists to remove, in which no Commitment is acceptable in either direction and no committed outcome can be reached at all.

payload.reason: critical objection finalized as a decline with the voting quorum unmet
